# Check for directory traversal vulnerabilities in filename input
def is_valid_filename(filename: str) -> bool:
    return not any(part in filename for part in ('..', '/', '\\'))

# Example usage
filename = "peters_mixtape.mp3"
assert is_valid_filename(filename) == True
filename = "../etc/passwd"
assert is_valid_filename(filename) == False
